A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same study and contain 21 readable pages. The text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E support a reliable comparison; all appendix pages are unchanged.

before.justification: v2 reports original model-output evaluations, layer-wise probing results and PCA/SAE analyses, including Table 1, Figures 2–9 and supplementary results in the appendices.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results, including the model-output comparisons, probing accuracies and representation analyses in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The prompt conditions, activation extraction, LR/TTPD probes, pretrained SAEs and feature-selection procedure are unchanged. The methodological descriptions are relocated without procedural revisions.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six curated topics and logical variants, numerical comparisons, CommonClaim and CounterFact. Appendix A and its dataset table are identical.

E2.justification: Figures 2–3 and Tables 3–4 retain LR and TTPD, while Table 1 retains the same seven model configurations. The newly cited Jin et al. work is not introduced as an evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: The reported 5k/1k/5k training/validation/test sizes, leave-one-topic-pair-out cross-validation, z-scoring, model configurations and evaluation metrics remain unchanged. The settings paragraph is moved without substantive revision.

E4.justification: The held-out generalization analysis, curated-versus-open-domain PCA comparisons, layer-wise SAE shifts and individual-feature scatter/violin analyses are retained. No ablation or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both report seed 1000, the same uncertainty entries in Tables 3–4 and the same Figure 6 description of shading as ±1σ across samples. No run-count disclosure or statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Table 1 and appendix Tables 3–4 contain identical numerical entries, and Figures 2–16 retain the same plotted results. The reported trends and qualitative findings also match.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), including the probe formulations and SAE distance/overlap definitions, are unchanged. Relocating the equations does not add or revise mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about linearly decodable instructed outputs, deception-induced representational shifts and a small set of deception-sensitive SAE features.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning token selection, superposition and feature reweighting are unchanged. The same limitations cover English declaratives, frozen weights, linear probes, binary factuality and the absence of causal interventions or adversarial prompt recombinations.

D1.justification: The solver settings, hyperparameters, SAE suites and feature counts, activation threshold, code link and promised data release are retained. Moving the implementation paragraph adds no reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 4 adds Jin et al. (2025), Exploring concept depth, to the discussion of internal truth-related signals, with a corresponding bibliography entry. The surrounding research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v4 moves implementation details ahead of SAE Feature Analysis and places these passages before Results & Discussion. It also replaces the equal-advising designation for Xiaotian Han and Pan Li with a corresponding-author designation for Pan Li; the remaining prose is essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3 moves from the left to the right column on page 5, accompanied by local text/equation reflow and bibliography reflow. Figure contents, captions, table structures and appendix layouts are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 placed SAE methodology and implementation details inside Results & Discussion; v4 places them in the preceding methods section, modestly clarifying the progression from setup to results. The added related-work citation slightly expands attribution. These are limited editorial gains; the empirical evidence and stated limitations remain unchanged.
